title: community-skills: A community hub for wrapping packages as agent-callable skills (v0.1.0)
description: community-skills is a public hub for exposing packages from any language ecosystem (R, Python, Julia, Stata, ...) as machine-readable skills that LLM agents (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, third-party tools) can invoke autonomously. Each skill ships a SKILL.md contract (function-level schemas), an invoke script in the package's native language, and a thin per-runtime bridge (subprocess + JSON) that any agent harness can drive. v0.1.0 implements the R bridge and ships bgumbel (Otiniano, Gabriel, Brom, Pereira 2023; ~48,000 CRAN downloads; 10 citing papers) as the canonical first skill, with placeholders for Python and Julia bridges to be contributed by the community. The repo is independent of any particular agent runtime: it requires only that the calling environment can spawn a subprocess and exchange JSON.
